title: 第1182章 被篡改的历史第1181章 青云契
content_zh:
陆长风真的是在感谢青元祖宗，只不过是八辈的！
什么他妈的青云契，这就是破界梭。陆长风之前虽没亲眼见过实物，可形态如此简单的东西，大师尊断然不可能画错。再说了，这自家的东西要是认不出来，二师尊肯定在地下咒自己……
话说破界梭本是破界刃的仿制品，乃救苦天尊亲自铸的。因为同样是徒弟，他给了大徒弟一个破界刃，小徒弟不能没有吧？
可是破界刃这等神兵，铸造材料实在太难找了，救苦天尊七拼八凑，堪堪凑齐。结果烧铸时把杂质一剔，不仅成品比破界刃短小许多，连造型都走样了。
得，花了九牛二虎之力铸了个四不像，救苦天尊也懒得再折腾，将其丢给当时还是无为的天孤子，让他拿着当飞刀耍。因为这古怪短刃上下窄中间宽，像个梭子，偏偏又能划动乾坤壁，所以取名破界梭。
后来，天灵至尊和天孤子在人界遭遇伏击，破界梭落到青元手上。这段历史，很多人不知道，陆长风却是属的，并深信不疑。要知道天灵至尊和天孤子可能会因立场问题存在诋毁万仙盟的嫌疑，说出的话没有十分的可信度，可鸿蒙战舰上的阴戾不可能说假话……
后来的事情，他想都不用想也能猜出大概。青元凭借破界梭回到仙界，还成了英雄，并成功抱得美人归。他将破界梭装了个玉手柄，送给云霓当定情信物。自此，仙界便流传着他们美好的爱情故事，破界梭也成了象征爱情的青云契。
虽然陆长风很欣赏少主这个人，也钦佩对方的学识，但是他确信，万仙盟一定篡改历史了，所以少主学的是假历史。这所谓的青云契更不是什么爱情象征，而是一段阴谋算计的见证……
“少主，林哥，我有些搞不明白。”陆长风指了指破界梭，又把目光转向身后的乾坤壁：“既然这东西能划动乾坤壁，我们为何不直接在那挖个洞？”
听了这话，少主微微一笑，尚未回应，林卫却忍不住笑出声来。
“你小子倒有几分机灵劲，不过没你想的那么简单。”
“林哥，怎么会呢，这本来就很简单。一堵墙而已，在上面挖个洞，这样咱们随时都能通过，也不用找人家借了，是不是？”陆长风说罢摆出一副大聪明的样子，意思是这么简单的道理，你们怎么想不明白。
“嘿，你小子……”林卫快被陆长风整无语了，这小子看任何问题都简单。
“这不行的，张强！”少主莞尔一笑，缓缓开口解说：“乾坤壁有独特的结构，必须顺着特定脉络下手才能划开，否则就算是青云契也无能为力。除非……”少主犹豫了下，还是将剩余的话说出来：“除非是传说中的破界刃方有这等威力！”
“哦，破界刃啊，我知道，六界第一神兵嘛，失踪很久了！”陆长风挠着头咧嘴，一脸惋惜，粗声叹道：“可惜了，没见过，我要是有这么个玩意就好了！”
林卫笑道：“你小子可真敢想，那可是第一神兵，轮到谁也轮不到你小子。”
“那是那是，那玩意号称第一神兵，自然只有少主这样的人才配用。”陆长风厚颜无耻地将自己拔高到和少主同样的位置，接着话锋一转道：“那个鬼乾坤壁居然要顺着切才能划开，这不跟那些老屠户割猪腿一个道理，顺着关节好下刀，不然遇到骨头就切不动。”
“哈哈……”
陆长风的话再次把两人逗笑了。但是他们不得不承认，这话糙理不糙，确实是这么个理。
关于乾坤壁要顺着特定脉络才能划开这个事，陆长风还真没试过。因为习惯的缘故，他每次破界都是沿着逍遥子标记的位置划，然后乾坤壁自己就愈合了。防割离，没想到乾坤壁居然还有这等妙用……

飞船继续向前，很快进入仙界境界，眼前景致随之一变。方才两界交界的苍茫混沌尽数褪去，入目是一片澄澈通透的天地，高空万里无云，天光和煦洒落，涤荡万物，视野开阔得看不到边际。
陆长风扶着船舷，低头俯瞰下方大地，眼底满是开阔之感。他早就知道仙界很大很大，比人界和神界加起来都要大，可仙界还是跟他想象中的大不一样。
极目所及，尽是平整肥沃的土地，原野绵延不绝，草木葱茏苍翠，灵气随风浮动，生生不息。更有数不清的江河溪流纵横交错，如万千玉带散落大地，水系四通八达，滋养着无垠疆土，处处透着温润富庶的气象。
大概是回归故土，少主心情不错，一边品茶，一边向陆长风解说。
“仙界疆域辽阔，沃土遍地，水系繁密，得天独厚，是九天灵机汇聚之地。但你要看的不仅是山水景致，而是仙界真正的格局。我与你细说一番，你日后在此修行立足，心中也好有分寸。”
“是，请少主教……那个赐教！”陆长风心中感激，少主考虑真的很周到啊！
“嗯。”少主目光望向苍茫仙界长空，条理清晰地说起格局：“仙界大体上也分为东西南北四域，不过这只是地域划分，算不得真正的势力格局。如今的仙界并非分封割据各自为政，而是统一的。凡仙界疆域，所有修行势力与凡尘仙民，包括世间百兽，尽归天庭统辖。”少主说到最后一句，语调微微上扬。
陆长风伸出大拇指赞道：“哇，少主，你爹……不是，咱天帝陛下好厉害啊，这么好的仙界都是他的，霸气！”
这……
说实话，这个举动要是换个人，可能会被解读为嘲讽，要么就是被少主认为阿谀奉承。可他是“张强”，那就很合理了。
果然，少主微微一笑，继续解说仙界核心体制：“不要误会，天庭是为全体仙界子民服务的，更有长老会监督。再者，天庭遵循民主，所有政令和律法皆由各方代表合议提出，长老会做最终裁决。所以，以后万万不能再说我父……天帝享有仙界这种话，容易被人误解！”
“是，属下记住了！”
陆长风这次没有嬉皮笑脸，郑重答应了。不过他心里清楚，有些话，少主不太方便说出口。
content_en:
Lu Changfeng was really thanking the Qingyuan ancestors, but they were only from the eighth generation!
What the hell Qingyun Deed, this is the boundary-breaking shuttle. Although Lu Changfeng had never seen the real thing with his own eyes before, it was absolutely impossible for the master to draw something wrong with such a simple shape. Besides, if he couldn't recognize his own thing, the Second Master would definitely curse himself underground...
It is said that the Boundary Breaking Shuttle is originally an imitation of the Boundary Breaking Blade, which was forged by Lord Jiku himself. Because he is also an apprentice, he gave the eldest apprentice a boundary-breaking blade. The younger apprentice can't live without it, right?
However, the casting materials for magic weapons such as the Boundary Breaking Blade are so difficult to find that the Ku Tianzun can only be pieced together. As a result, when the impurities were removed during the casting process, not only was the finished product much shorter and smaller than the boundary-breaking blade, but the shape was also out of shape.
Yes, it took a lot of effort to create a four-dimensional image, but Tian Zun, who saved the suffering, was too lazy to mess with it anymore, and threw it to Tian Guzi, who was still inaction at the time, and let him use it as a flying knife. Because this weird short blade is narrow at the top and bottom and wide in the middle, like a shuttle, but it can also paddle the wall of the universe, so it was named Boundary Breaking Shuttle.
Later, Tianling Supreme and Tianguzi were ambushed in the human world, and the world-breaking shuttle fell into Qingyuan's hands. Many people don’t know about this period of history, but Lu Changfeng belongs to it and firmly believes in it. You must know that Tianling Supreme and Tian Guzi may be suspected of slandering the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance due to their stance. What they say is not very credible, but it is impossible for Yin Rui on the Hongmeng Battleship to tell lies...
He could roughly guess what happened next without even thinking about it. Qingyuan returned to the fairy world with the help of the boundary-breaking shuttle, became a hero, and successfully embraced the beauty. He installed a jade handle on the boundary-breaking shuttle and gave it to Yun Ni as a token of love. Since then, their beautiful love story has spread in the fairy world, and the boundary-breaking shuttle has become a Qingyun contract symbolizing love.
Although Lu Changfeng admired the young master as a person and admired his knowledge, he was convinced that the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance must have tampered with history, so what the young master learned was fake history. This so-called Qingyun Deed is not a symbol of love, but a witness to a conspiracy...
"Young Master, Brother Lin, I don't understand something." Lu Changfeng pointed at the boundary-breaking shuttle, and then turned his gaze to the Qiankun Wall behind him: "Since this thing can move the Qiankun Wall, why don't we just dig a hole there?"
After hearing this, the young master smiled slightly, but before he could respond, Lin Wei couldn't help laughing.
"You're a bit smart, but it's not as simple as you think."
"Brother Lin, how could it be? This is very simple. It's just a wall, dig a hole in it, so we can pass through it at any time, and we don't have to ask anyone to borrow it, right?" Lu Changfeng said with a smart look, meaning such a simple truth, why can't you understand it?
"Hey, you kid..." Lin Wei was almost speechless by Lu Changfeng. This kid sees any problem easily.
"That won't work, Zhang Qiang!" The young master smiled and slowly explained: "The Qiankun Wall has a unique structure, and it must be cut along a specific line, otherwise even Qingyun Qi can't do anything. Unless..." The young master hesitated for a moment, but said the rest of the words: "Unless the legendary boundary-breaking blade has such power!"
"Oh, the world-breaking blade, I know, the number one magic weapon in the six realms, has been missing for a long time!" Lu Changfeng scratched his head and grinned, with a look of regret on his face, and sighed in a rough voice: "It's a pity, I haven't seen it before. I wish I had such a thing!"
Lin Wei smiled and said: "You guys really dare to think about it. That is the number one magic weapon. No one's turn will be yours."
"That's right. That thing is called the number one magic weapon. Naturally, it can only be used by people like the young master." Lu Changfeng shamelessly raised himself to the same position as the young master, and then changed the topic: "The ghost wall must be cut along the way to cut it open. This is not the same as those old butchers cutting pig legs. You should cut along the joints, otherwise you will not be able to cut the bones."
"Haha...…”
Lu Changfeng's words made the two of them laugh again. But they had to admit that whether this was a rough statement or not, it was indeed the truth.
Regarding the fact that the Qiankun Wall can only be opened by following a specific line, Lu Changfeng has never tried it. Because of habit, every time he broke the boundary, he drew along the position marked by Xiaoyaozi, and then the Qiankun Wall healed itself. To prevent separation, I never expected that the Qiankun Wall could have such a wonderful effect...
The spaceship continued to move forward and soon entered the fairyland, and the scenery in front of it changed accordingly. The vast chaos at the junction of the two worlds just now faded away, and what came into view was a clear and transparent sky and earth. There were no clouds in the sky. The sky was warm and scattered, washing away everything. The field of vision was so wide that the edges could not be seen.
Lu Changfeng held onto the side of the boat, lowered his head and looked down at the land below, with a sense of openness in his eyes. He had long known that the fairy world was very big, larger than the human world and the divine world combined, but the fairy world was still very different from what he had imagined.
As far as the eye can see, there is flat and fertile land, endless wilderness, lush vegetation, and spiritual energy floating in the wind, endlessly growing. There are also countless rivers and streams criss-crossing the earth, like thousands of jade belts scattered across the earth. Water systems extend in all directions, nourishing the boundless territory, and there is a warm and prosperous atmosphere everywhere.
Probably returning to his hometown, the young master was in a good mood. While sipping tea, he explained to Lu Changfeng.
“The Immortal World has a vast territory, fertile soil everywhere, dense water systems, and is uniquely blessed by nature. It is a place where the nine heavens gather their wisdom. But what you want to see is not only the scenery of mountains and rivers, but the real pattern of the fairyland. Let me explain it to you in detail so that you can gain a foothold in practice here in the future, and you will feel more confident in your mind. "
"Yes, please young bishop... please enlighten me! "Lu Changfeng was grateful, the young master was really thoughtful!
"Hmm. "The young master looked at the vast sky of the Immortal Realm and spoke clearly about the structure: "The Immortal Realm is generally divided into four regions: east, west, north and south. However, this is only a geographical division and cannot be regarded as a real power structure. Today's fairy world is not divided into separate kingdoms, but unified. In the realm of mortal immortals, all cultivating forces and mortal immortals, including all beasts in the world, are under the jurisdiction of heaven. "When the young master said the last sentence, his tone rose slightly.
Lu Changfeng extended his thumb and praised: "Wow, young master, your father... No, our Emperor of Heaven is so powerful. Such a wonderful world of immortality belongs to him, so domineering! "
This...
To be honest, if this move were made by another person, it might be interpreted as ridicule, or considered by the young master as flattery. But he is "Zhang Qiang", so it makes sense.
Sure enough, the young master smiled slightly and continued to explain the core system of the Immortal Realm: "Don't get me wrong, the Heavenly Court serves all the people of the Immortal Realm, and is supervised by the Council of Elders. Furthermore, the Heavenly Court follows democracy. All decrees and laws are proposed by representatives of all parties through consensus, and the Council of Elders makes the final decision. Therefore, in the future, you must never say that my father...the Emperor of Heaven enjoys the immortal world, it is easy to be misunderstood! "
"Yes, I have remembered it! "
Lu Changfeng did not smile playfully this time and solemnly agreed. However, he knew in his heart that there were some words that it was not convenient for the young master to say.
